description: This file defines a PHP trait 'EndpointExceptionTrait' that provides utility methods for generating and throwing exception objects related to API endpoint errors in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating specific exception instances like BadRequestException, NotImplementedException, etc., and for throwing exceptions based on certain conditions.

methods.name: getBadRequestException
methods.description: Returns a new instance of BadRequestException with a provided message or default message.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Returns a new instance of NotImplementedException with a provided message or default message.

methods.name: getRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Returns a new instance of RecordNotFoundException with a provided message or default message.

methods.name: getForbiddenException
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ForbiddenException with a provided message or default message.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfNotExist
methods.description: Throws a RecordNotFoundException if the provided entity does not exist or is not of the expected class.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfEmptyIds
methods.description: Throws a RecordNotFoundException if the provided array of entity IDs is empty.

methods.name: getInvalidParamException
methods.description: Creates and returns an InvalidParamException populated with InvalidArgumentExceptions for each parameter key.
